errors.evidence: The x-axis does not follow a standard logarithmic scale; the intervals are custom (1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, etc.). It should be described as a custom or non-linear scale.
The orange line, corresponding to 'SepLLM (n=64)', has vertical tick markers, not circle markers. The red line has circle markers.

errors.text_span: rises to a peak of 100% at 4e8 TFLOPs
errors.evidence: The orange line for 'SepLLM (n=64)' peaks slightly above 100% at 4e8 TFLOPs. Stating the peak is exactly 100% is inaccurate and misses the detail of overshooting the baseline.
The blue line for 'SepLLM (n=128)' never reaches 100%. At 2e8 TFLOPs, it is at approximately 99.8% and remains below 100% for the rest of the range.
The green line for 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' reaches 100% earlier, at approximately 2e8 TFLOPs, and later peaks slightly above 100% at 6e8 TFLOPs.
The red line, corresponding to 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)', has circle markers, not square markers.
The red line reaches approximately 98.6% at 2e8 TFLOPs, not 99%. It reaches its peak of about 99.1% later, at 4e8 TFLOPs.

errors.text_span: then plateaus near 99% for the remainder of the range
errors.evidence: The red line does not plateau. After its peak at 4e8 TFLOPs, it fluctuates and shows a slight downward trend. Describing this as a plateau is an oversimplification of the trend.
